svg.title: Rebound
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/2022/contemporary-art-evening-sale-2/rebound; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
